description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating fingerprint authentication with asymmetric key cryptography, including key creation, signature initialization, and UI interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling fingerprint authentication, key management, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up fingerprint security checks, creates key pair, and configures button click behavior.

methods.name: initSignature
methods.description: Initializes the Signature object with the generated private key for signing operations.

methods.name: onPurchased
methods.description: Handles successful purchase by showing confirmation.

methods.name: onPurchaseFailed
methods.description: Handles purchase failure by showing a toast message.

methods.name: showConfirmation
methods.description: Displays confirmation message and encrypted data if available.

methods.name: createKeyPair
methods.description: Generates an asymmetric key pair in the Android Keystore with user authentication required.
